we propose La MAML, an efficient online meta learning algorithm that achieves state-of-the-art performance on real world visual recognition tasks for continual learning.

(1) La MAML, an optimisation based meta-learning algorithm for continual learning, is fast, online and achieves superior performance to other replay based and prior based approaches; and (2) La MAML achieves this by modulating the meta-learning update with the gradient of a novel meta loss, which we refer to as a meta-gradient, that can be used to improve the performance of meta learning algorithms in continual learning
